Name: Farmer's Water Pipe
Author: Talooth
Description:
This is a simple sprite retexture mod, adding in a water pipe, in exchange for SOMETHING ELSE *dun-dun-dun!*
Based on Sebastian's "vase," the pipe retextures the Decorative Bowl, yes, turning it into a "Decorative Bowl," (it's pune, or play on words)

I've included the edited Tile Sheet as an image, and an image of pipe. If you know how to edit sprites on your own, feel free to replace whatever you like, or alter the coloration, or even apply the graphic to an item (I recommend an alcohol if you're going to.) The world is your oyster.


Install:
1. Download
2. Open the downloaded file
3. Open the "Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets" file path, wherever it's located
4. Backup your furniture.xbn file (so you can change it back without any trouble)
5. place the furniture.xbn file from the downloaded file into the TileSheets file. Click "copy and replace."
6. Open Stardew Valley to make sure everything is correctly working.
7. Enjoy! Or, chuckle slightly... Or tell me it's horrible... Or.. I don't know.

Uninstall:
1. Remember the back up file?
2. Say "oh yeah, I do remember, glad I made it."
3. Drop it in the TileSheets folder. Click "copy and replace."
4. Let me know that your experience was less than satisfactory.

Probable conflict:
Anything that replaces the furniture.xbn file. If you want to use other replacements that also effect the furniture.xbn file, you'll need to edit the sprite sheet yourself. Here's the [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/beginners-guide-to-xnb-node-and-graphics-editing.110976/]guide I used[/url], if I can understand it, you probably can as well. 

Plans: (yes, I have plans for a bo- water pipe, in a game about farming. too much time, not enough to do with it.)
At a later date I will be adding in other colors, lit, unlit, clean and used versions, I just can't be asked to right now, being as I'm a bit very lazy. (currently it is blue, lit and clean.)
I will not be adding any functionality to the pipe. I'm a self described I.T. guy for ranching community, who works Tier I tech support on the side, not a programmer. Anything that can't be explained in a few simple paragraphs is well beyond my skill level. Sorry about that. If you want this the pipe to do anything... Well, let me know what you come up with, I would be very interested to see it in action XD
I may change the name of the item later. Right now I have no idea how to so, or if it's possible (I assume it is, I also assume it's beyond my skill level, so don't hold your breath)... Yeah, sorry... This isn't my forte, can you tell?
